sync.text: Yenza ifolda entsha ku-OneDrive, Dropbox, iCloud Drive noma Google Drive, uyikhethe lapha, bese ukhetha ifolda efanayo kwamanye amakhompyutha akho. Imisebenzi, amafayela nenkumbulo kuyakulandela; izilungiselelo nokhiye kuhlala kukhompyutha ngayinye.
sync.safe: Imisebenzi yakho, amafayela nenkumbulo nakho kusefoldeni {folder}, kuphephile ngisho noma isiphequluli sakho sikusula lapha.
sync.waiting: Vumela ukufinyelela efoldeni {folder} ukuze uqhubeke uvumelanisa namanye amakhompyutha akho.
sync.failed: Ifolda {folder} ayifinyeleleki. Ingabe isekhona kule khompyutha?
sync.refused: Ifolda {folder} inamanye amafayela. Khetha ifolda entsha engenalutho, noma leyo ovumelanisa nayo kwenye ikhompyutha.
